parallels.note: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

translations.web: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
translations.bsb: They looked, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
translations.kjv: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
translations.asv: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.
